item.title: [ZEPPELIN-5310] SPARK_HOME in zeppelin-env.sh doesn't take effect in yarn cluster mode
item.description:
We built from source on March 26th with commit  85ed8e2e51e1ea10df38d4710216343efe218d60. DeployMode: Cluster is broken in this build. When we try to use cluster mode we see the following error:
